description.fun: Rockruff is a friendly puppy with a collar of rocks, often recommended to new Trainers, and it greets people by rubbing those rocks against them. It never forgets a smell, and there are tales of lost Rockruff finding their Trainers by following the faintest scent. As it grows it gets wilder and starts howling at sundown, and it may leave its Trainer for a while, coming back once it has evolved.
description.guide: Rockruff is a Rock-type puppy Pokémon from Alola, said to have lived alongside humans since ancient times. It has an excellent sense of smell. It evolves into Lycanroc at level 25, and which of three forms it becomes depends on the time of day and its Ability.
description.tagline: A loyal puppy with a rocky collar and an unforgettable nose

branches.text: Which Lycanroc Rockruff becomes depends on when it evolves and on its Ability. Level it up during the day for Midday Form or at night for Midnight Form; a Rockruff with the Own Tempo Ability evolves in the evening into Dusk Form instead.

description.fun: Lycanroc's form depends on the light Rockruff evolved under: Solgaleo's solar energy, Lunala's lunar energy or the setting sun. Midday Form is a calm, sleek wolf with a sun-shaped ring of razor-sharp rocks in its mane; it lives alone to avoid needless fights and darts past foes, slashing as it goes. Farmers keep Lycanroc to guard their fields from Deerling, and broken bits of its stone mane are thought to bring good luck.
description.guide: Lycanroc is a Rock-type wolf Pokémon that evolves from Rockruff, in Midday, Midnight or Dusk Form depending on when it evolves. Midday Form is a swift, loyal four-legged wolf, Midnight Form a reckless, werewolf-like fighter, and Dusk Form a mix of the two. Its name combines lycanthrope and rock.
description.tagline: A rock wolf that takes after the sun, the moon or dusk

description.fun: Rockruff that evolve at night become this red, werewolf-like Lycanroc with a crescent-moon mane. It's thrilled by strong opponents, its eyes glowing with excitement, and it goads foes into attacking, then knocks them out with a counterblow; its headbutts can smash giant boulders.

Only a Rockruff with the Own Tempo Ability that evolves at sunset becomes this orange-gold Lycanroc, which mixes Midday Form's calm loyalty with Midnight Form's fighting spirit. It's considered the rarest form, and its green eyes may come from the green flash sometimes seen as the sun sets.

transitions.how: Level 25, at dusk, with the Own Tempo Ability
